about: Cases of a copy's building-floor listings (private/plans/done/floor-brush-plan.md, 3.8): native_copy.floor_at and copy_floors, and the editor's floors.js floorAt and copyFloors, give these results. Buildings are indexes; a listing is [building, floor, cutdown]; here and there are [building, floor] or null.

floorAt.case: the floor whose volumes overlap the box most
volumes of one floor add up
a tie: the first building and floor win
a box touching a volume's face only stands in none
a flat surface (no thickness) stands in none

copyFloors.case: a piece listed nowhere: its copy is listed nowhere
listed though it stands in no floor (a ladder on an outer wall), copied to none either: it keeps its listings
copied out of every floor: none
copied up a floor of its building
two listings move to another building, as far above the floor it stands in as they were
its CutdownFloor moves by as many floors
moved down, a CutdownFloor stays at least 1; 0 names none and stays
standing in no floor but copied into one: the listings go to the copy's floor, no rise
listed in another building than the one it stands in: no rise
